content:
Investment Market Price

Record market prices for investments to track their current value.

Market prices are used to calculate unrealized gains and portfolio valuations.

Date

Select the date for which you are recording the market price. This is typically the date shown on a valuation statement or market quote.

Investment

Select the investment for which you are recording the market price.

Currency

If the investment is priced in a foreign currency, select that currency here. Leave blank if priced in your base currency.

Market price

Enter the market price per unit/share of the investment as of the specified date.

Exchange rate

Enter the exchange rate to convert the foreign currency price to your base currency. Click Autofill to use the system exchange rate for this date.

ExchangeRateIsInverse

Check this box if you want to enter the exchange rate in reverse format (e.g., instead of 1 USD = 0.75 EUR, enter 1 EUR = 1.33 USD).
